typeBlock.description: This GDDI type is used to carry an echo of a space vehicle command. These messages are typically transferred from a ground modem to a FEP application for comparing against the transmitted command to ensure integrity of the uplink.

tlv.description: Length in bits of the command echo data block. (Default: 0)
Identifier used to match command requests and command echoes. (Default: 0)
Type of encoding representing the command echo data: (0: Binary, 1: Dibit, 2: Tribit). (Default: 0)
Echo Status: (0: Successfully compared with command or fill command, 1: Miscompared with command, 2: Timeout waiting for echo, 3: Unexpected echo). (Default: 0)
Time that this echo was received by the downlink receiver. This represents the number of non-leap seconds elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
